jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for Assistant Vice-President, Global Realty Services, Project Management Office and Asset Manager for Singapore, Malaysia and Brunei reporting directly to Vice-President – Global Realty Services, APAC ex. India.
You will responsible for leading and managing the APAC ex. India GRS Project Management Office, ensuring the successful execution of Facilities and Capital fit out/refurbishment/Life cycle projects delivery, and maintaining alignment with the organization's strategic goals including Global initiatives as well as leading the onsite CBRE Facilities Operations and Engineering team. In addition, this role is responsible for the Real Estate strategy under the remit, in collaboration with the Global Transaction Team. This position plays a pivotal role in driving project efficiency, standardization, enforce governance framework and overall project management and facilities operational excellence within the organization.
This role must also be instrumental in managing challenging and ambiguity situations with stakeholders and other project members, with the ability to read the room, articulate key message across, and achieve the desired results.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As a Global Realty Services you will:
Key Responsibilities
Program Management Office (PMO) – APAC (50%)
APAC Project Portfolio Management:
Oversee the organization's project portfolio within the APAC region, actively participating in project intake, prioritization, and resource allocation decisions specific to APAC.
Partner and support the APAC Facilities team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement, in tandem with Global policies.
Develop and implement a visionary APAC PMO strategy that aligns with the organization's global strategic objectives.
Collaborate with APAC ex India GRS senior leadership to ensure that regional project initiatives align with the organization's long-term vision and global goals.
Regional Project Governance:
Define and enforce project governance structures, processes, and standards within the APAC region, ensuring consistent adherence across all projects.
Establish and maintain project charters, roles, and responsibilities, and regularly review project governance for enhancements within APAC.
Project Delivery Excellence:
Proactively monitor and assess project progress, budgets, and timelines within the APAC region, taking corrective actions when necessary to ensure successful project delivery.
Champion risk management practices specific to APAC projects and escalate issues to senior management as needed.
Resource Management and Development:
Strategically allocate and optimize project resources within the APAC region, including project managers, business analysts, and other critical roles.
Foster a learning environment within the APAC Facilities, providing training and growth opportunities for team members based in APAC.
Continuous Improvement Champion:
Continuously evaluate and enhance project management methodologies, processes, and tools within the APAC region to ensure best practices are followed.
Encourage a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the APAC Facilities team and collaborate with other regions to share insights and best practices.
Stakeholder Engagement:
Establish and maintain robust communication channels with stakeholders in the APAC region, ensuring transparency and alignment with project objectives.
Provide regular, concise project status updates and reports to keep APAC stakeholders informed.
Facilities and Asset Management (40%)
Lead and develop the onsite CBRE Facilities Team, supported by their APAC Alliance Director
Review and approve facilities operating expense budget, forecasting, variance reporting and accrual management.
Explore and implement efficient ways to improve facilities services through approved digitalization,
Collaborate with other Asset Managers to maintain reporting, policies, physical security, EHS procedures and protocols.
Lead and support local CBRE Facilities Manager in the respective sustainability efforts as a sponsor.
Prepare and organize presentations and analytical reports for regular team meetings.
Liaise with regional team leaders to organize monthly operation reports.
Data Analytics
Maintain department information library and support regional team leaders to ensure that folders structures are maintained.
Provide support for property management and administration through research, filling, data entry and reporting of real estate information.
Transaction Management (10%)
Be the point of local GRS contact in site inspection, selection and support APAC ex India GRS VP in preparation of business case, with collaboration with the Global Transaction team
Support the local lease administrative process
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Critical thinking and maintain a growth mindset, comfortable to challenge the status-quo
Proactiveness - Anticipating the needs of colleagues and stakeholder and eagerness to complete assigned duties. Results driven.
Adaptability – Adapt and work effectively across a multitude of different situations;
Independent learner and Resourcefulness – Eagerly explore new tools, technologies, and processes; quickly learn to use new technologies as they are introduced;
Team Oriented – Collaborate in a team environment (both inhouse and external vendors/consultants; possess a sense of accountability and urgency in completing assignments in support of the team’s success
Experience in preparation and presentation of Facilities and Real Estate business cases.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in a related field (Project Management, Facilities, Real Estate, Business Administration, etc.). PMP certification is highly preferred.
Minimum 5 years of work experience in Facilities Project Management, Real Estate in a MNC environment.
Proven track record of successful project management leadership, with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in PMO.
Proficiency in project management software and tools (e.g. Microsoft Project, Jira, Trello).
Good understanding of basic accounting and financial principles.
Excellent in understanding in the real estate cycle principles and its dynamics
Experience working in a highly matrix and complex MNC organisation
Additional Requirements
Familiarity with operational resilience, business continuity, audit, and governance frameworks.
Work Requirement
Normal office hours

Job Description
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Audit Manager, Vice President to join our regional audit team. Located in Singapore you need to have a deep understanding of State Street’s range of businesses and services, including Custody, Markets, and Investment Services. A deep understanding of MAS is also required, and experience of regulations across other Asia Pacific jurisdictions will be an advantage. You should have a demonstrable background in applying data analytics techniques and a desire to influence audit execution through additional technologies.
The role is located in Singapore and applies a hybrid model of 4 days on site, 1 day remote.
Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role you will strive for cutting-edge solutions, that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best. Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As a Senior Audit Manager, Vice President, you will be responsible for audit activities in Singapore, while contributing to the broader outcomes of the Asia-pacific and global audit teams. Specific activities include:
Owning and executing a portfolio of audit projects, managing the planning, assessment, testing and reporting phases in line with audit methodology and OKR standards.
Work as part of a regional team, collaborating closely with peers to provide oversight of entity related projects, appropriately recording applicability and outcomes.
Contribute to regional and global initiatives for the further development and improvement of the audit function
Actively adopting and promoting the use of technology tools to increase audit assurance.
Develop and maintain stakeholder relationships across the portfolio, increasing risk insight and awareness
Proactive development of team members, enabling the achievement of goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across the organization, including the banks' resiliency and technology organization.
Communicate audit progress, findings and recommendations effectively to senior management.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Experience leading and supervising audit projects, preferably within the global financial services industry.
Proficiency in evaluating business risks and testing internal controls while applying risk based testing approaches.
Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, working independently and developing relationships with global stakeholders in a fast paced environment.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership ability across all levels coupled with effective problem solving, conceptual thinking, quantitative and analytical skills.
Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and technical writing skills.
Advanced project management skills.
Fluency in English - written and spoken. Additional language skills are an advantage.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in business administration or a financial services related field.
8+ years of experience auditing one or more of the product suite offered by State Street
Audit or assurance experience working in the banking or financial services industry or other regulated industries.
Expertise in understanding and evaluating regulatory requirements
Relevant certifications, such as CIA or CISA are highly preferred.
Additional Requirements
May require occasional travel (up to 10% of the year)

Not Applicable

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
Join State Street Markets as the
Head of Markets Client Engagement, APAC, Managing Director
. You will be responsible for leading client engagement efforts across the Markets product suite, both internally and externally, to accelerate growth of the business. You will work collaboratively with Markets product sales and business leadership to define and execute our roadmap for client and commercial growth in the APAC region, as an extension of the global commercial and client strategy.
As a senior regional representative of the Markets franchise, you will connect client needs with the full breadth of State Street capabilities, coordinate the right product and relationship teams around priority opportunities, and ensure strategic engagement results in clear follow-through and measurable commercial outcomes.
The ideal candidate combines deep capital markets expertise with strong commercial judgment, executive presence, and the ability to mobilize teams across a complex global organization. You should be equally comfortable engaging senior clients, shaping account-level priorities, navigating regional nuances, and driving disciplined execution across multiple products and stakeholders.
This position will report directly to the Head of Markets Commercial & Client Strategy.
Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining is part of State Street Markets. As a leading provider of trading and lending solutions to the world's institutional investors, we deliver innovative platforms, financing, liquidity, and execution solutions supported by differentiated research, data, and market intelligence.
We are strengthening how Markets engages clients across products, regions, and the broader State Street franchise. APAC represents a strategically important region with diverse client segments, market structures, and growth opportunities. Realizing that opportunity requires a coordinated approach that moves beyond individual product conversations and presents Markets as a connected set of capabilities aligned to each client's business priorities.
This role will be responsible for establishing the Commercial & Client Strategy framework in APAC and embedding a consistent, commercially rigorous model for client prioritization, engagement, and follow-through. The successful candidate will help convert senior dialogue and strategic access into actionable opportunities, strengthen connectivity across Markets and the broader firm, and build a more visible and accountable pipeline of relationship growth.
Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As the
Head of Markets Client Engagement, APAC, Managing Director
, you will:
Lead commercialization efforts and drive measurable growth with new and existing clients across Markets offerings, by establishing the CCS framework in the region
Maximize the commercial impact of client-facing engagements, curating target client audiences in the region to optimize commercial impact, and converting strategic client engagement into measurable ROI and relationship growth
Be the Markets central point of contact for a subset of top-tier client relationships in the region, both internally and externally
Execute Markets-wide targeted client strategies in concert with Markets Sales leadership, aligned to the Firm’s strategy, client objectives and Markets growth priorities, while leveraging the Firm’s resources, balance sheet and thought leadership
Partner with Client Executives and sales and relationship management teams across Investment Services and Investment Management to promote Markets capabilities and solutions to deliver One State Street to APAC top GCD clients
Represent Markets at industry conferences and State Street led symposiums with a focus on promoting the Markets brand which includes a holistic set of liquidity, financing, and research solutions
Promote Markets innovative award-winning product, platform and thought leadership internally and externally to acquire new and deepen existing client relationships
Champion a client-led, collaborative culture across the region, reinforcing consistent messaging, shared accountability, and a disciplined focus on commercial outcomes.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Deep understanding of capital markets and the needs of institutional investors, with experience across one or more Markets businesses such as foreign exchange, financing, securities lending, or research and advisory solutions.
Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect client priorities, product capabilities, relationship dynamics, and firm economics.
Executive presence and credibility with senior clients and internal leaders, including the ability to represent a broad franchise rather than a single product.
Proven ability to develop strategic client relationships, originate commercial dialogue, and translate engagement into concrete opportunities and accountable follow-through.
Ability to influence across a highly matrixed, global organization and align stakeholders with different product, regional, and functional priorities.
Strong understanding of APAC institutional markets, regional client segments, and the importance of adapting global strategies to local market context.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate complex Markets capabilities as a clear, client-relevant proposition.
Analytical mindset and comfort using client, revenue, product, and activity data to guide prioritization and commercial decision making.
Collaborative leadership style with the ability to build trust across Sales, Product, Relationship Management, and senior business leadership.
Ability to balance strategic perspective with practical execution, operating discipline, and attention to detail.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Minimum of 15 years of experience in capital markets, institutional sales, client coverage, relationship management, commercial strategy, business development, or related roles.
Demonstrated success leading complex client relationships or regional commercial initiatives within a global financial institution, investment bank, asset manager, securities services organization, or market infrastructure provider.
Strong knowledge of institutional client needs and buying dynamics across asset managers, asset owners, financial institutions, official institutions, or other relevant client segments.
Experience working across multiple Markets products and coordinating integrated solutions across product and organizational boundaries.
Established network and credibility within APAC institutional markets, with the ability to engage effectively across different countries, cultures, and seniority levels.
Proven track record of influencing senior stakeholders, mobilizing cross-functional teams, and advancing opportunities without relying solely on direct authority.
Experience using CRM, account planning, pipeline management, client analytics, or related commercial tools to improve focus and accountability.
Bachelor's degree required; MBA, CFA, or other relevant advanced degree or professional qualification preferred.
Additional Requirements
Ability to travel regularly across APAC and, as required, to other global locations.
Ability to operate effectively across time zones in a global, highly matrixed organization.
Ability to build credibility quickly with senior clients, business leaders, and product specialists while driving alignment across competing priorities.
Ability to manage ambiguity, exercise sound judgment, and lead complex client and commercial initiatives from strategy through execution.

Assist with onboarding new administrative operators.
Coordinate data setup and maintenance with the Fund Connect development team.
Investigate and resolve client inquiries and production issues.
Review account balances for completeness and source updated data as needed.
Build and maintain relationships with portal providers.
Monitor data, trade, and file-transfer integrations and coordinate issue resolution.

Participate in testing and training for new features.
Assist portal operators with maintaining user acceptance testing (UAT) environments, including balance updates and fund information.
Collect and track testing feedback and enhancement requests.
Ensure adherence to operational procedures and develop new procedures as needed.
Participate in periodic service-level agreement (SLA) reviews.
Design and implement operational controls to mitigate risks associated with new business.
Participate in the regional production-support schedule, including off-hours coverage as needed.
Assist with developing and implementing process-monitoring tools, workflow-management tools, and client data-sharing workflows.
Liaise with fund companies on trading, fund maintenance, and onboarding activities.
Support direct and non-direct money market trading models for Fund Connect clients.
Advance strategic initiatives established by GlobalLink and Global Markets.
Manage holiday calendars and client notifications.
Review fund information on the platform for completeness and accuracy.

Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Strong technical aptitude and proficiency with a broad range of applications, including Microsoft Office, Grafana, Freshdesk, Microsoft Teams, and other virtual collaboration tools.

Comfort working in a remote environment, including participating in virtual training and providing and receiving feedback.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
State Street is seeking a Cryptographic Key Management Operations Engineer to support the end-to-end lifecycle management of cryptographic keys across cloud, on-premises, infrastructure, and IoT environments. This role is responsible for ensuring the secure generation, distribution, rotation, revocation, and retirement of encryption keys while maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and enterprise security policies.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in cryptography and key management operations with a mindset focused on operational excellence, automation, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, and application teams to maintain the availability, reliability, and security of enterprise key management services that support critical financial systems and business operations.
What You Will Be Responsible For
Support the day-to-day operation and security of enterprise cryptographic key management services, ensuring compliance with financial industry regulations and standards, including PCI DSS, GDPR, FIPS 140-3, and NIST guidance.
Manage the complete cryptographic key lifecycle, including secure key generation, storage, distribution, rotation, revocation, escrow, and retirement across cloud, on-premises, and IoT environments.
Monitor, investigate, and respond to key management incidents, including key compromise, expiration, policy violations, and operational failures, ensuring timely remediation and risk mitigation.
Maintain the availability, integrity, and security of key management infrastructure, troubleshooting issues and ensuring adherence to service level objectives.
Partner with cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, engineering, and DevSecOps teams to integrate cryptographic services into enterprise applications, platforms, and security frameworks.
Automate and optimize key management processes using APIs, Key Management Systems (KMS), infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and security orchestration technologies.
Support secure transaction processing and data protection by ensuring highly available and resilient key management services.
Develop and maintain operational procedures, standards, runbooks, and technical documentation related to key management services.
Produce operational, compliance, and risk reporting related to key usage, lifecycle events, service performance, and audit requirements.
Stay current with emerging cryptographic technologies, evolving threat landscapes, post-quantum cryptography developments, and regulatory requirements to continuously improve key management practices.
What We Value
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex cryptographic and infrastructure-related issues.
A proactive approach to operational excellence, automation, and continuous service improvement.
The ability to work effectively across multiple teams and disciplines in a highly regulated and security-focused environment.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear operational and business outcomes.
A risk-focused mindset with a commitment to maintaining the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of sensitive data and cryptographic assets.
A passion for staying current with advances in cryptography, cloud security, emerging technologies, and industry best practices.
Attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high standards of security, governance, and operational discipline.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
3+ years of experience supporting cryptographic operations, key management platforms, information security, or cybersecurity services within a financial services organization or other regulated industry.
Strong understanding of cryptographic key lifecycle management, including symmetric and asymmetric encryption, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), certificate management, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).
Hands-on experience with enterprise key management solutions such as AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, OCI Vault, and Fortanix DSM.
Knowledge of security and compliance standards including PCI DSS, FIPS 140-3, NIST, ISO 27001, and related regulatory requirements.
Experience supporting cloud-native security services and enterprise encryption implementations.
Familiarity with IoT security, embedded cryptography, and device identity management.
Experience leveraging SIEM and monitoring platforms to support security operations and key access monitoring.
Experience with automation and scripting technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Terraform, or similar tools.
Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or equivalent certifications are preferred.
Exposure to post-quantum cryptography (PQC), cryptographic agility programs, and emerging cryptographic frameworks is highly desirable.
